commands.name: wait
commands.description: Wait server-side until a member condition holds, then optionally act in the same frame. Sync waits hold the exec queue (every other command waits behind them, including one the condition may depend on) — keep them short and self-contained; set async=true and poll job wait_status for anything else.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition to wait for: { member, target?, findType?, op, value }. member is a dotted path (static, or instance under target/findType); op is equals|notEquals|greaterThan|lessThan|contains|changed.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait (default 30, clamped to 0-600). A sync wait reports timedOut slightly before it, so the reply lands first.

parameters.name: poll_interval_ms
parameters.description: How often to re-check the condition, in milliseconds (default 100, clamped to 16-5000; must be finite).

parameters.name: on_met
parameters.description: Follow-up run in the same editor frame the condition first holds: { capture: { view, source, save_path, width, height, include_image }, pause }.

parameters.name: return_history
parameters.description: Include the observed value/timestamp samples (a ring buffer of the last 200, so the tail near the transition is kept).

parameters.name: tolerate_missing
parameters.description: Treat resolution failures (type/member/instance not found) as condition-not-met and retry until timeout, instead of failing fast. Enables waiting for something to exist (e.g. a spawned object via findType).

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Return a wait_id immediately and evaluate in the background; poll job wait_status and cancel with job wait_cancel. Use this for long waits and whenever the condition depends on a command you still need to issue — a sync wait blocks it.

schema.title: job wait
schema.description: Wait server-side until a member condition holds, then optionally act in the same frame. Sync waits hold the exec queue (every other command waits behind them, including one the condition may depend on) — keep them short and self-contained; set async=true and poll job wait_status for anything else.

member.description: Dotted member path. With no target/findType it is a fully-qualified static path (e.g. "UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying"); with target/findType it walks instance members (e.g. "State" or "Health.CurrentHealth"). Read-only members only.

target.description: Object handle (instanceId / hierarchyPath / guid / path / globalId) to read instance members from. Omit for a static member path or to use findType.

findType.description: Fully-qualified UnityEngine.Object type name; the member walks from its first loaded instance. Alternative to target.

op.description: Comparison: equals (default) | notEquals | greaterThan | lessThan | contains (strings) | changed (met on first change from the initially observed value; needs no value). changed is for value-like members (primitives/enums/strings); content mutations inside a reference-typed member are not detected.

value.description: Comparison operand, coerced to the member's type (primitive, enum name, or string). Required for every op except 'changed'. equals/notEquals accept an EXPLICIT null (e.g. wait-until-destroyed: a destroyed leaf value observes as null); omitting the key entirely is rejected.

condition.description: Condition to wait for: { member, target?, findType?, op, value }. member is a dotted path (static, or instance under target/findType); op is equals|notEquals|greaterThan|lessThan|contains|changed.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait (default 30, clamped to 0-600). A sync wait reports timedOut slightly before it, so the reply lands first.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to re-check the condition, in milliseconds (default 100, clamped to 16-5000; must be finite).

view.description: Which view to capture: game (default) or scene.

source.description: Game view only: 'camera' (default) renders a camera and misses Screen Space - Overlay UI; 'screen' captures the composited game view incl. overlay canvases (HUDs), Play Mode only.

save_path.description: Project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/victory.png).

include_image.description: Also return the PNG inline as base64 (default false: path-only when save_path is set).

capture.description: Capture the game or scene view the moment the condition holds (reuses the capture command internals).

pause.description: Pause play mode on the frame the condition holds (no-op outside play mode).

on_met.description: Follow-up run in the same editor frame the condition first holds: { capture: { view, source, save_path, width, height, include_image }, pause }.

return_history.description: Include the observed value/timestamp samples (a ring buffer of the last 200, so the tail near the transition is kept).

tolerate_missing.description: Treat resolution failures (type/member/instance not found) as condition-not-met and retry until timeout, instead of failing fast. Enables waiting for something to exist (e.g. a spawned object via findType).

async.description: Return a wait_id immediately and evaluate in the background; poll job wait_status and cancel with job wait_cancel. Use this for long waits and whenever the condition depends on a command you still need to issue — a sync wait blocks it.

commands.name: wait_cancel
commands.description: Cancel an async wait started with job wait (async=true).

schema.title: job wait_cancel
schema.description: Cancel an async wait started with job wait (async=true).

commands.name: wait_status
commands.description: Get the status/result of an async wait started with job wait (async=true).

parameters.name: wait_id
parameters.description: The wait id returned by job wait when async=true.

schema.title: job wait_status
schema.description: Get the status/result of an async wait started with job wait (async=true).

wait_id.description: The wait id returned by job wait when async=true.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a UPM package by name@version, git URL, or 'file:' local path. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package status); pass wait=true to block until added. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll script recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Package to add: 'com.unity.foo@1.2.3', a git URL, or 'file:../Path'.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview the change without applying it.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the operation completes and return the result (synchronous). Default: return immediately and poll package status.
